purpose: Author-authorized formal-result migration, 25Q3 secondary-endpoint standardization, and homogenization uncertainty supplement
known_results: Historical/seed123 CellOT scores and per-release DepMap value checks were known; homogenization intervals and the new formal M6 summary had not yet been generated
unchanged: A003 corrected object and negative values
Original uploaded DOCX and AI disclosure
Historical results, checkpoints, and v1.2.0 public archive

cellot.decision_chronology: The training recipe was registered before training; formal adoption was explicitly authorized after results were known to provide a fully documented formal execution path. Both contexts are replaced together, without selecting seeds, targets, or metrics.
cellot.migration: Reuse all completed retraining and scored values; recompute BH for the 18 formal endpoint/identity tests and affected M4 correlations/M6 summaries; retain historical outputs separately

gene_effect_sensitivity.historical_hepg2_jurkat_match: All 2701 finite values and missingness match 23Q4, with maximum error 4.44e-16; this does not recover historical download logs or the internal Chronos commit
gene_effect_sensitivity.cohort: Within each context's existing probability-evaluable cohort, require nonmissing shift/probability/25Q3 gene effect for the same targets; do not change the formal eligible object
gene_effect_sensitivity.statistic: Spearman(raw mean-absolute shift, -gene effect), compared with probability and historical gene effect on the same targets for provenance/sensitivity
gene_effect_sensitivity.bh_family: The eight-context 25Q3 gene-effect tests form a separate family, excluded from primary inference

homogenization_uncertainty.scope: All formal outputs and displayed diagnostic references in HCC and Replogle
homogenization_uncertainty.unit: Target, not target pair; remove the same target from predicted and observed matrices
homogenization_uncertainty.centering: After each deletion, recompute predicted and observed means across remaining targets separately and recenter
homogenization_uncertainty.interval: Full estimate +/- t(n-1,0.975)*sqrt((n-1)/n*sum((leave-one estimate-mean leave-one estimate)^2)), intersected with theoretical range [-1,1] or excess range [-2,2]
homogenization_uncertainty.zero_vectors: Retain A004 zero-vector threshold 1e-12; if the full or any leave-one estimate is undefined, report interval NA with the reason, not zero
homogenization_uncertainty.interpretation: Approximate target-level intervals conditional on saved outputs; exclude training randomness, cell-sampling uncertainty, and cross-context generalization; not used for significant model rankings

public_release: Generate a new version matching formal results; the old v1.2.0 DOI must not represent it. Backfill after publication and actual download recomputation
